title: From Identifiable Causal Representations to Controllable Counterfactual Generation: A Survey on Causal Generative Modeling
reasoning: The paper provides a technical survey of causal generative modeling and its applications in fairness and privacy. While it addresses 'fairness' and social bias, it does not evaluate, benchmark, or study religious topics, faith, specific moral judgments, or formal ethical frameworks like deontology or utilitarianism.
